fusions.name: Drowsy Hiss
fusions.desc: A slow hiss in a 4-tile cone that deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance per hit to leave it [Hindered] for 5 seconds, its attacks slowed.

fusions.name: Sunbaked Lunge
fusions.desc: A strike from stillness that deals 28 damage as a critical hit and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Dropped Tail
fusions.desc: Veils you for 5 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 20% faster while veiled, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Regrown Plume
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, you regain 4 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
